scripts.build:shared: npm --prefix packages/shared-types ci && npm --prefix packages/shared-types run build
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix packages/shared-types run build && npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix apps/web run build -- --configuration production
scripts.build:api: npm --prefix packages/shared-types run build && npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web && npm run build:api
